inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Monitor Privilege user Self Service Password Reset (SSPR)

properties.description:
This rule detects when privileged accounts (e.g., Global Admin, Security Admin, Exchange Admin, etc.) perform a Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) in the last 7 days.

Since privileged accounts hold elevated access, their password resets should be carefully monitored for potential account compromise or abuse of self-service reset policies
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Monitor Privilege user Self Service Password Reset (SSPR)
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where OperationName =~ "Reset password (self-service)"
| extend TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| extend InitiatedBy = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend modifiedProperties_ = tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties)))
| extend displayName_ = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| where TargetUser has_any (
    // List of privileged roles
    "admin", 
    "Global Administrator",
    "Privileged Role Administrator",
    "Security Administrator",
    "Exchange Administrator",
    "SharePoint Administrator",
    "Teams Administrator"
)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, TargetUser, InitiatedBy, Result, ActivityDateTime
| order by TimeGenerated desc
